history.description: A matte navy field built from soft light that changes per chapter: window light with drifting dust, a large viewfinder frame with a blue left edge, depth contour lines sweeping away, four rising light fader slots with one warm channel, and a single breathing glow.

passes.passDescription: Composite layered blue-noise grain over the scene.

definitions.name: progress
definitions.description: Chapter progress 0-1 (0 hero window light, 0.3 viewfinder, 0.5 depth scan, 0.7 light desk, 0.9 voice glow). Adds to the built-in scroll trigger, so keep it 0 when relying on scroll.
